summary:
ASTRA: Space Missions is a browser-based 3D educational game that puts players in charge of a complete space mission—from designing a spacecraft and launching a multistage rocket to landing and exploring the Moon or Mars.

Set in 2061, the story follows a fictional Indonesian space agency working to restore interplanetary communications after a powerful solar storm. Players must balance budget, mass, fuel, power, and communications while choosing equipment for their mission. On the surface, they manage oxygen and energy, explore the environment, and conduct scientific experiments through interactive minigames.

Every design choice affects gameplay, turning engineering trade-offs into challenges players can experience directly. A mission review explains outcomes and encourages players to refine their designs.

Built with TypeScript, Three.js, and Vite, ASTRA features procedurally generated visuals and audio. The project aims to make space science and engineering approachable through experimentation, problem-solving, and discovery.
details:
ASTRA: Space Missions is a browser-based 3D educational game that lets players design, launch, land, and operate a space mission on the Moon or Mars. Players assemble spacecraft while balancing budget, mass, fuel, power, and communications. They then pilot a multistage rocket, land their spacecraft, and explore the surface while managing oxygen and energy.

Scientific activities become interactive minigames, including photography, drilling, spectrum matching, and seismic calibration. A mission review connects outcomes to design choices, helping players understand engineering trade-offs and improve through experimentation.

The project aims to make space engineering accessible to students and support STEM learning through hands on problem solving. Its story follows a fictional Indonesian space agency restoring interplanetary communications after a solar storm, with an Indonesian-language interface.

We developed ASTRA using TypeScript, Three.js, Vite, HTML, and CSS, with Vitest for automated testing. Models, terrain, textures, music, and sound effects are generated procedurally through code and the Web Audio API.

ASTRA’s creative approach connects mission planning, piloting, and exploration in one continuous experience. Our team considered scientific concepts, approachable controls, meaningful failure feedback, performance across different devices, and offline operation after local setup. These choices support classroom demonstrations and independent exploration.
